name: Strawberry
summary: AI browser with companions that research, extract data, draft and run scheduled tasks across websites.
description: Strawberry is a web browser with built-in AI companions that learn your workflows and can work across any website and connected apps (Gmail, Slack, Notion...) — e.g. sourcing candidates, building lead lists or drafting follow-ups. Browsing is free; credits are used only when companions act. Free 500 credits/month; Intern $20/month; Part-Time $85; Full-Time $250.
features: AI companions acting on any website
